info.name: Scorecard Management
info.description:
Complete API collection for Scorecard Management module.

Base URL: {{base_url}}/agentic/reporting/api/v1/scorecard

Set the following collection variables before running:

- base_url : e.g. [http://localhost:3000](http://localhost:3000)
    
- auth_token: JWT token from login

body.raw:
{
  "name": "Customer Service QA Scorecard",
  "description":"This guide is designed to support both **Evaluators** and **CSRs** in understanding and applying the Call Scorecard accurately and consistently. Each question includes clear expectations, performance indicators, common challenges, and examples of what meets or does not meet the standards. For Evaluators, it serves as a reference for fair and consistent scoring. For CSRs, it offers insight into how performance is measured and how to meet expectations during interactions.",
  "channel": "INBOUND_CALL",
  "enabled": true,
  "created_by": "sandeep.rawat@vimo.com",
  "updated_by": "sandeep.rawat@vimo.com"
}

request.description:
Creates a new scorecard. The service auto-generates scorecard_id, lineage_id, sets version=1 and status=DRAFT.

Required fields: name, state, channel, created_by, updated_by
channel enum: INBOUND_CALL | OUTBOUND_CALL | CHAT | TICKET | AGENT_ASSIST

request.description:
Fetches the full scorecard document plus all its questions.
Replace {{scorecard_id}} in collection variables or in the URL directly.

response.name: 200 OK

originalRequest.description:
Fetches the full scorecard document plus all its questions.
Replace {{scorecard_id}} in collection variables or in the URL directly.

request.description: Returns all versions (v1, v2, v3 …) of a scorecard, sorted newest first, grouped by lineage_id.

originalRequest.description: Returns all versions (v1, v2, v3 …) of a scorecard, sorted newest first, grouped by lineage_id.

request.description: Updates metadata fields on a DRAFT scorecard. Only DRAFT scorecards can be updated. scorecard_id is required; all other fields are optional.

originalRequest.description: Updates metadata fields on a DRAFT scorecard. Only DRAFT scorecards can be updated. scorecard_id is required; all other fields are optional.

request.description: Transitions a DRAFT scorecard to PUBLISHED state. Sets published_at timestamp automatically. Only DRAFT scorecards qualify.

originalRequest.description: Transitions a DRAFT scorecard to PUBLISHED state. Sets published_at timestamp automatically. Only DRAFT scorecards qualify.

request.description: Clones any existing scorecard version into a new DRAFT. Generates new scorecard_id and section_ids while preserving lineage_id and all question_lineage_ids. The version number is auto-incremented to max(existing versions)+1.

originalRequest.description: Clones any existing scorecard version into a new DRAFT. Generates new scorecard_id and section_ids while preserving lineage_id and all question_lineage_ids. The version number is auto-incremented to max(existing versions)+1.

request.description: Transitions a PUBLISHED scorecard to DISABLED. Sets disabled_at timestamp automatically. Only PUBLISHED scorecards qualify.

originalRequest.description: Transitions a PUBLISHED scorecard to DISABLED. Sets disabled_at timestamp automatically. Only PUBLISHED scorecards qualify.

request.description: Archives a scorecard regardless of its current state. Sets archived_at timestamp automatically.

originalRequest.description: Archives a scorecard regardless of its current state. Sets archived_at timestamp automatically.

request.description:
Adds a new section to a DRAFT scorecard. The service auto-generates section_id and section_lineage_id. The weighting values across all sections should sum to 100.

Required: scorecard_id, name, sequence, weighting, updated_by

originalRequest.description:
Adds a new section to a DRAFT scorecard. The service auto-generates section_id and section_lineage_id. The weighting values across all sections should sum to 100.

Required: scorecard_id, name, sequence, weighting, updated_by

request.description:
Updates fields of an existing section on a DRAFT scorecard. Only include the fields you want to change. All fields except scorecard_id and section_id are optional.

Required: scorecard_id, section_id, updated_by

originalRequest.description:
Updates fields of an existing section on a DRAFT scorecard. Only include the fields you want to change. All fields except scorecard_id and section_id are optional.

Required: scorecard_id, section_id, updated_by

request.description:
Removes a section from a DRAFT scorecard. Also deletes all question documents belonging to this section and decrements total_questions accordingly.

Required: scorecard_id, section_id, updated_by

request.description:
Creates a new question document and links it to the specified section. Auto-generates question_id and question_lineage_id. Pushes the question_lineage_id into the section's questions array and increments total_questions.

Required: scorecard_id, scorecard_lineage_id, section_id, section_lineage_id, question_text, question_type, max_points, weight, created_by, updated_by
